card.name: Reconstitution and preparation wording
card.fires_on: Mostly the start of 'reconstitute' or 'reconstituted' (the 'Re' or 're' piece) and small words like 'to' or 'by' in drug preparation and administration instructions. It also fires on scattered split words in general web text.
